about: The product's own ST-LINK_gdbserver session stops on the reference board, cycle after cycle, recorded by tests/bench/st_link_gdbserver_recordings.py (test_record_st_link_session_stops). Round `direct`: the server opened the probe's USB itself and was killed at each stop. Round `shared`: the server reached the probe through stlink-server (`-t`) and was killed at each stop.

direct.bundle: STM32CubeCLT 1.22.0 for Linux, extracted from its installer without running it
direct.gdb_version: GNU gdb (xPack GNU Arm Embedded GCC x86_64) 14.2.90.20240526-git
direct.image: the demo firmware the tier builds
direct.probe: the bench's in-circuit debugger, its serial number redacted
